headline_result.statement: motif destruction is ABSORBING under the frozen kernel at H=6: 19 of 42 unconstrained-support rollouts broke the protected motif and 0 recovered, so endpoint validity implies path validity and endpoint-only filtering is sufficient by dynamics, not luck

binary_headroom.note: greedy is already at ceiling, so any stage-B planning headroom would have been 0 BY DEFINITION

secondary_finding.statement: endpoint_only failed to RETURN anything on 2/6 sources (all rollouts ended motif-invalid) while the masked arms succeeded 6/6
secondary_finding.caveat: n=6 with 2 events; existence proof, not a rate
secondary_finding.why_not: different and weaker claim: absorption plus wasted budget, not excursion and return

price_of_the_guarantee.note: essentially free where endpoint_only returns anything at all

external_evidence.finding: GraphXForm action masking is pathwise only over valence/atom type/atom count/bonding legality; ring-size and bonding-pattern constraints are a TERMINAL filter (molecule_evaluator.py::infeasible_by_special_constraints on mol.synthesis_done); no SMARTS or substructure matching in the repo
external_evidence.consequence: the strongest published graph-editing comparator instantiates this lane's endpoint_only arm, so the capability gap is real; but with G1 failing the consequence of that gap is academic in this regime

criteria.V1_non_vacuous: at least one violator, not all violating

reversibility_census.consequence: pathwise constraints leave the main paper; the ring-system negative goes to the appendix; no fourth predicate searched
reversibility_census.failure_mode_distinction: C is VACUOUS (0 violations, dead for a scientific reason). A and B are genuinely REVERSIBLE (return rates 1.000 and 0.857, far above the 0.10 floor) and fail on EVENT COUNT alone, which is a property of the 42-trajectory pool inherited from the 6-source smoke panel.

family_B_excursion_depth.interpretation: excursions well inside the corridor width are real departures; a high count of boundary-noise excursions would mean the return statistic is an artifact of where the bound happens to fall

escalated_to_lead.question: family B (cLogP corridor) is reversible and failed only the 20-event bar on an inherited 42-trajectory pool; does the reversibility question deserve a powered answer?

bounded_run_that_would_settle_it.also_resolves: V4 (mask retention), which the current shards cannot answer

escalated_to_lead.explicitly_forbidden: lowering the 20-event bar to convert B into a pass

stage_a2.deferred_reason: every A2 trajectory would be generated under the frozen R_theta that lane 1 is deciding whether to discard; spending ~2.1 container-hours now risks measuring a model about to be replaced
stage_a2.framing_verbatim: Family B was selected for follow-up AFTER the three-family feasibility census because it alone exhibited the intended reversible-excursion mechanism. Stage A2 is developmental follow-up, not independent confirmation of the phenomenon.

panel.new_eligibility: cLogP(x_0) inside the corridor -- applicability, not tuning

stage_a2.uncertainty: source-clustered bootstrap; trajectory level carries no interval

V4a_median_retention.provenance: no cLogP-mask data exists in this lane, so it cannot be fitted

V5a_source_spread.provenance: downstream sizing: 60-source confirmatory panel needing ~20 informative sources -> 1/3; 24-source development panel needing ~8 -> 1/3

V5b_max_single_source_share.provenance: keeps the clustered bootstrap from collapsing to n~1

stage_a2.v5a_disclosure: stage A's family-B events came from 2/6 panel sources = 0.333, numerically equal to V5a. The denominators are NOT comparable: stage A did not require x_0 inside the corridor and only 3 of 6 sources were source-feasible. Under A2's definition the stage-A analogue is 2/3 = 0.667, so V5a sits at HALF the previously observed value.
can_fail_cleanly: events concentrated on one or two molecules -> V5a / V5b

costed_plan.cost_basis: measured stage A: 123 s startup + 14.3 s per kernel call

stage_a2.if_r_theta_is_replaced: A2 as written is void; corridor, criteria and analysis carry over but the panel and any results must be regenerated. Do not reuse stage-A shards across a model change.
